thesis: The site is a printer's proof sheet: every section is one page in the job folder, with crop marks at its corners, a registration target and a color bar that holds that section's swatches; the homeowner reads the page like a client approving a print run.

signature.name: Printer's Marks
signature.summary: Every section framed by four L-shaped crop marks with a registration target top-right and a vertical color bar left holding swatch chips; each proof carries a mono proof number matching the quote form step. Footer is the APPROVED stamp line. Hook: data-sw-signature='proof-marks'.

motion.intro: Crop marks draw in at hero tool panel corners; color bar fills swatch by swatch (3 chips, 200ms stagger). H1 readable before animation.
stories: Pinned rowhouse wall mockup cycles sketch → color proof → approved stamp on desktop; stacked cards with clip reveal on mobile.
motion.hover: Hairline under nav links and buttons grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms.
